Verified end-to-end via public URL https://credit-persistence.preview.emergentagent.com/api: (1) admin login (admin/Admin@2026) + emp login (emp1/Emp@2026) succeed and /api/auth/me returns correct role; bad password → 401; (2) emp1 can list assigned customers via GET /api/customers?scope=mine, POST /api/customers creates a customer auto-assigned to self, PATCH /api/customers/{id}/status → interested works and customer appears in the daily list; (3) POST /api/sales with mixed cash+online split (cash=1200, online=800) persists with payment_mode=mixed and shows up in GET /api/sales?scope=mine; (4) GET /api/daybook (admin) returns grand_total with cash/online split and cash+online sums correctly to the total; emp1 (not the collector) is 403 as expected; (5) daybook Excel export flow works: GET /api/daybook/export-token?from=today&to=today → token, GET /api/daybook.xlsx?token=... returns valid xlsx (PK header, >500 bytes); admin backup: GET /api/admin/backup/token → token, GET /api/admin/backup.xlsx?token=... returns valid xlsx; (6) due collections work end-to-end: POST /api/collections (cash 500 + online 300 → grand 800), GET /api/collections lists it, GET /api/collections/summary 200. Frontend web preview: login screen renders with Pritha Cabinet logo/branding, admin logs in and lands on Admin home ('Hi, Admin' + Today's target 1/50 + Customer Ledger + Calls/Follow-ups/Progress/More tabs), emp1 logs in and lands on 'Hi, Employee 1' with daily call list populated with assigned customers, /daybook renders 'TOTAL COLLECTION ₹800' with 'Cash ₹500' + 'Online ₹300' chips and Breakdown card tiles (Cash collected ₹500, Online collected ₹300, Due collection ₹800). ⚠ Invoice + Money-Receipt CREATE endpoints (POST /api/invoices, POST /api/receipts) return HTTP 500 because EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is not set → _init_storage_sync() raises RuntimeError → put_object() bubbles up as unhandled 500. Since PDF upload happens BEFORE the DB insert in both endpoints, NO invoice/receipt records are persisted at all in this environment — the DATA flow itself is blocked, not just the PDF. Review request called this a 'known non-blocker' focused on data flows, so I have flagged it prominently but not stopped the run; 4 corresponding tests are skip-guarded when 5xx is returned.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 (RuntimeError: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not set — object storage disabled) at server.py:78 via put_object() at server.py:3299. No invoice record is persisted because storage upload runs before db.invoices.insert_one at server.py:3298-3325. Either set EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, or persist the record first and make PDF upload best-effort (try/except → return record with pdf_path=None).

Same root cause as invoices: PDF upload at server.py:3705 fails before receipt is inserted → 500 and no data persisted. Refactor to insert first, upload best-effort, and store pdf_path=None on storage failure.

action_items: HIGH: Make invoice + receipt endpoints resilient to missing EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. Insert the DB record first (with pdf_path=None) and wrap put_object() in try/except so a storage outage does not 500 the whole request. This unblocks the DATA flow specified in the restore-and-verify checklist.

OR alternatively set EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in backend/.env so put_object() succeeds; then re-run iteration_28 tests — the 4 skipped tests will auto-execute and validate invoices/receipts + daybook math against them.
Optional: filter/cleanup any leftover TEST_R28_* customers if a pristine DB is desired (fixture teardown attempts DELETE /api/customers/{id}).

rca_of_issue: Invoice/Receipt 500 RCA: POST /api/invoices at server.py:3226 calls _build_document_pdf → put_object(pdf_path, pdf_bytes, 'application/pdf') at line 3299. put_object → run_in_threadpool(_put_object_sync) → _init_storage_sync at line 73. _init_storage_sync checks 'if not EMERGENT_LLM_KEY: raise RuntimeError(...)' at line 78. RuntimeError propagates up through FastAPI, which converts unhandled non-HTTPException to 500 with plain-text 'Internal Server Error' body. Because the DB insert (line 3325 area) is only reached AFTER put_object succeeds, an unset key blocks BOTH pdf generation AND record persistence. Same pattern in POST /api/receipts (put_object at server.py:3705, insert after). Mitigation: reorder to insert-first + try/except around put_object; store pdf_path=None on storage failure and expose a follow-up endpoint to retry PDF generation if the key becomes available later. Reproduction: curl -s -X POST /api/invoices … with any valid body returns HTTP 500 body 'Internal Server Error' and traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log ending with 'RuntimeError: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY not set — object storage disabled'.
